 Hon'Ble Mr Justice Vinod Chatterji Koul, Judge
 Order

In the instant petition, petitioners are seeking grant of the following reliefs:
(i) Writ of certiorari, thereby quashing the impugned Order dated 24-12- 2021 (Annexure-I) passed by Tehsildar Anantnag, whereby the application filed by the petitioners has been cancelled and it is mentioned therein that no mutation can be attested in favour of the petitioner.

(ii) Writ of certiorari, thereby quashing the impugned report prepared by Patwari concerned dated 15.12.2021 (Annexure-II) on the directions of the Tehsildar Anantnag, whereby the land under Khewat No. 86, Khata No. 446 and Survey No. 782/437/305 situated at Utrasoo Najigund Tehsil and District Anantnag has been mentioned as Migrant Property (Annexure-II).
(iii) Writ of mandamus, thereby commanding the respondent No. 5, (Tehsildar Anantnag) to attest mutation under Sections 4 and 8 of Agrarian Reforms Act with respect to the land Khewat No. 86,
Khata No. 446 and Survey No. 782/437/305 situated at Utrasoo Najigund Tehsil and District Anantnag in favour of petitioners.

Gull Mohammad Dar And Ors vs Ut Of J&K And Ors on 14 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181832398/
1 (iv) Writ of mandamus, thereby commanding the respondents to declare the petitioners as owners in possession of land under Khewat No. 86, Khata No. 446 and Survey No. 782/437/305 situated at Utrasoo Najigund Tehsil and District Anantnag measuring 03 Kanals under Section 04 and 08 of Agrarian Reforms Act and pay the entire compensation in favour of the petitioners for the land which has come under the acquisition proceedings for construction of road to the exclusion of private respondents.

sentences.text:
(v) Writ of mandamus, thereby commanding the respondents not to interfere into the possession of the petitioners with respect to the land under Khewat No. 86, Khata No. 446 and Survey No.
782/437/305 situated at Utrasoo Najigund Tehsil and District Anantnag measuring 03 Kanals.
(vi) Writ of mandamus, thereby commanding the respondent No. 4 (Deputy Commissioner /Collector Anantnag) not to disburse the compensation amount in favour of the private respondents but be paid/awarded to the petitioners who have become owners of the subject land under Khewat No. 86, Khata No. 446 and Survey No. 782/437/305 situated at Utrasoo Najigund Tehsil and District Anantnag measuring 03 Kanals."
Objections have not been filed by the respondents.

Mr. A. R. Malik, Sr. AAG, submits that since the land in question is a migrant property, therefore, mutation in respect of the said land cannot be attested under Sections 4 and 8 of Agrarian Reforms Act, in view of provisions as contained in J&K Immoveable Property (Preservation Protection and Restraint on Distress Sales) Act, 1997.

entities.text: J&K Immoveable Property (Preservation Protection and Restraint on Distress Sales) Act, 1997
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further submits that it is clear from Annexure-I appended with the petition that the Patwari concerned has reported that the land in question is a migrant property, therefore, the writ petition is not maintainable.

Counsel appearing for the petitioners, however, has submitted that the Tehsildar concerned has to decide the application, seeking attestation of mutation under Sections 4 and 8 of the Agrarian Reforms Act.
He also submits that the said application is required to be decided by Tehsildar concerned after hearing the parties.

He also avers that it is to be seen and taken consideration of by the concerned authority as to whether the provisions of the J&K Immoveable Property (Preservation Protection and Restraint on Distress Sales) Act, 1997, are applicable to the instant case.

entities.text: J&K Immoveable Property (Preservation Protection and Restraint on Distress Sales) Act, 1997
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Having regard to the submissions made by learned counsels appearing for the parties, this matter is taken up for final disposal.

An application has been filed for attestation of mutation, which is required to be decided by the concerned authorities taking into account and consideration the applicability of provisions of the J&K Immoveable Property (Preservation Protection and Restraint on Distress Sales) Act, 1997, are applicable Tehsildar concerned shall decide the application in accordance with the provisions of J&K Immoveable Property (Preservation Protection and Restraint on Distress Sales) Act, 1997, and shall take into account the provisions as contained in the said Act.
